verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no public REST or GraphQL API: no API reference, no API keys or tokens, and no endpoints for programmatic access. The only programmatic surface shown is the Thoropass MCP server (list audits, update evidence requests). That capability belongs to the separate MCP-server story and does not transfer to a documented public API. The IP allowlist and integrations items describe inbound data collection, not an API that users can call to drive the product.
